name: 0Delta.ai
description:
0Delta lets Claude pull Exact Online numbers and your finance reports, handy if you’re a fractional CFO or founding partner juggling one company or a whole portfolio.

Ask about cash runway, burn, P&L, balance sheet, open invoices, customer concentration, or how the forecast compares to actuals. Scan the portfolio for who needs attention, then dig into one company or Exact division without opening the ERP.

You sign in with your 0Delta.ai account. Curated reports work best for analysis; use the live Exact Online tools when you need to reconcile or drill down.

You’ll need an active 0Delta account with Exact Online connected.

_published_faq.name: How do I add 0Delta.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add 0Delta.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.0delta.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the 0Delta.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: 0Delta.ai lists 27 MCP tools, including compare_periods, get_aging_receivables, get_bank_entries, get_bank_entry_lines, get_cashflow_forecast, get_customer_concentration, get_expected_cashflows, get_export_refresh_status, get_financial_statements, get_forecast_variance, get_gl_transactions, and get_headcount_trend.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to 0Delta.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to 0Delta.ai in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
0Delta.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
0Delta.ai is developed by Sofritech B.V.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
